name: Twenty-two house crests replace the official Japan icon in FrontEnd and in game (Japan map 15 km), with setup and diplomacy ribbon screenshots

steps.code: local function check(names) local sizes={22,30,32,36,44,45,48,50,64,80,128,200,256}; for _,size in ipairs(sizes) do local jx,jy,jsheet=IconManager:FindIconAtlas('ICON_CIVILIZATION_JAPAN',size); local seen={}; for _,name in ipairs(names) do local icon='ICON_CIVILIZATION_JAC_'..name; local x,y,sheet=IconManager:FindIconAtlas(icon,size); if x==nil or y==nil or not sheet or not string.find(sheet,'JAC_Crests'..size,1,true) then error('house crest '..icon..' size '..size..' resolves to sheet='..tostring(sheet)..' x='..tostring(x)..' y='..tostring(y)) end; if sheet==jsheet and x==jx and y==jy then error(icon..' resolves to the official Japan icon at size '..size) end; local key=tostring(x)..':'..tostring(y); if seen[key] then error('duplicate atlas position '..icon..' and '..seen[key]..' size '..size) end; seen[key]=icon end end end; check({'ODA','TAKEDA','DATE','ASHINA','HOJO','YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI','NAGAO','IMAGAWA','MATSUDAIRA','ASAKURA','ASHIKAGA','MIYOSHI','ROKKAKU','HONGANJI','OUCHI','AMAGO','MORI','CHOSOKABE','OTOMO','SHIMAZU','RYUKYU','AINU'}); return '22 unique crests resolve at all 13 sizes'
OnAdvancedSetup(); return 'advanced setup opened for crest inspection'

local function check(names) local sizes={22,30,32,36,44,45,48,50,64,80,128,200,256}; for _,size in ipairs(sizes) do local jx,jy,jsheet=IconManager:FindIconAtlas('ICON_CIVILIZATION_JAPAN',size); local seen={}; for _,name in ipairs(names) do local icon='ICON_CIVILIZATION_JAC_'..name; local x,y,sheet=IconManager:FindIconAtlas(icon,size); if x==nil or y==nil or not sheet or not string.find(sheet,'JAC_Crests'..size,1,true) then error('house crest '..icon..' size '..size..' resolves to sheet='..tostring(sheet)..' x='..tostring(x)..' y='..tostring(y)) end; if sheet==jsheet and x==jx and y==jy then error(icon..' resolves to the official Japan icon at size '..size) end; local key=tostring(x)..':'..tostring(y); if seen[key] then error('duplicate atlas position '..icon..' and '..seen[key]..' size '..size) end; seen[key]=icon end end end; local names={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName(),'^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if not f then error('non-JAC major '..PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()) end; names[#names+1]=f end; if #names~=22 then error('expected 22 majors, got '..#names) end; check(names); local x,y,sheet=IconManager:FindIconAtlas('ICON_CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA',22); print('[JAC_CRESTS] in-game ODA 22px '..tostring(sheet)..' '..tostring(x)..','..tostring(y)); return 'in-game: all 22 majors use their own crest cell at all 13 sizes'
